name: Humanitarian funding gap
summary: WFP cuts Gaza food aid for 500,000; Burundi refugees face cuts without funding
state: WFP cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people from late October after receiving less than half its usual funding (WFP; UN News). About 125,000 refugees in Burundi face food assistance cuts without urgent funding (DevelopmentAid). No new pipeline break in a famine-risk country was reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: No action needed; UN agency appeals list how to support humanitarian operations.

sources.title: WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce assistance in Gaza
UN News — Funding cuts leave half a million without food assistance
DevelopmentAid — 125,000 refugees in Burundi face food cuts

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
